Weather comes from NASA's Curiosity weather station archive (Gale Crater, 2012 to 2018). It shows a real recorded day from the same Mars season as today (the same data as the Forecast tab), adjusted to the place on the map and the time of day. It is not a live feed.

REMS ARCHIVE
Each day shows a real record from the Curiosity weather archive for the same Mars season, adjusted to this place. The archive has no wind or dust values.
